properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): review_relations writes only `evidence`, so every CONTRADICTS it draws takes the schema default `alignment: opposing`; 10 edges whose own evidence says "alignment=supporting" are stored opposing, and 9 are reported as contradictions
properties.source: root-cause skill run 2026-10-13 over the committed copy at main c58305ba8 and live detect_defects
properties.statement:
ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured on main c58305ba8 and the live design, 2026-10-13; RUN AS THE SKILL, root-cause fetched fresh).

1 OBSERVED: 93 CONTRADICTS edges, 55 `opposing` and 38 `supporting`. 10 of the opposing ones carry evidence that says in words "alignment=supporting" or "corroboration, not conflict" (e.g. fact:the-linking-discipline-reproduced-its-own-finding-2026-08-30 CONTRADICTS cap:search-first-at-the-tool). Each stores exactly {alignment: opposing, evidence}. detect_defects reports 9 of them as contradictions (heal:70d4e842a92aadaf, heal:8d4ae0308730b5aa, heal:120c0b59fb37331b, heal:f660a760ca6a9652, heal:243253b5bfcb11a3, heal:5958ba71686aebf4, heal:9f4dfee2481b30f3, heal:1cd8225c12b486c6, heal:90f5a328414adf9d); the tenth touches a rejected decision and is suppressed. Expected: a corroboration recorded as one. NOT affected: the detector, which skips alignment=supporting (heal.rs; ver:supporting-is-not-conflict passes), and create_edge, whose props can set alignment.

2 PRECEDENT: fact:the-causes-edge-carries-a-full-rca-vocabulary-that-no-served-tool-can-set (2026-09-22), the same shape on CAUSES.

3 CAUSE: review_relations, the route the brainstorm and capture-intent skills send an agent to for CONTRADICTS, takes relation, other_id, evidence, incoming, other_design and other_name (RelationLinkReq, deny_unknown_fields, crates/reflow2-mcp/src/service.rs), and writes Props::new().set("evidence", ...) (crates/reflow2-core/src/relate.rs). schema/inference.yaml declares alignment {default: opposing}, which materialises on create. A writer who means "supporting" has no field to say it in, writes it into the evidence, and the default asserts the opposite.

4 REFUTED: "the detector ignores alignment" (it reads it; the stored value is opposing). "The writers forgot a field they had" (the instructed route has none; create_edge could set it, but no skill sends a relation there). UNSEPARATED: which route drew each of the 10 edges. An edge records no writer route, so "drawn through review_relations" is inferred from the evidence wording, not measured per edge.

5 CLASS: a relation-drawing route that writes only evidence lets every defaulted edge property speak for the writer: CONTRADICTS alignment=opposing, CAUSES basis=correlational and validation_status=unvalidated, DUPLICATES basis=suspected, DEPENDS_ON optional=false and weight_basis=estimated. Only alignment is read as a defect today. The 2026-07-28 fix (the detector reads alignment) could not have stopped this, because the instructed writer cannot write the property.
